speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To begin our assessment, how old are you in hours of life, and is this your first pregnancy for your mother?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity (32 weeks gestation) and maternal diabetes.

Since you were born via cesarean section and your mother had gestational diabetes, I am concerned about lung immaturity and surfactant deficiency. Do you have any cyanosis or grunting sounds while breathing?
